description: X-TAIL results (CLIP ViT-B/16, RAIL's single prompt). 'settings': the final run on held-out seeds 11-15; 'replication_seeds_6_10': the earlier held-out run (no reverse gate). table[t][d] is the accuracy (%) on domain d after learning domains 0..t; Transfer/Average/Last as in RAIL's code. The tuning protocol and gate sensitivity checks use seeds 6-10; the Transfer headroom analysis uses development seeds 1-5 and validation.
